summary.text: Joe Lombardo is the incumbent Republican Governor of Nevada, seeking a second term. A former Clark County sheriff, he was elected in 2022. His campaign highlights his record on education, health care, public safety and the economy; he has pledged no new taxes, vetoed a record number of bills from the Democratic-controlled Legislature, and backed a 2024 ballot question requiring voter ID.

paragraphs.text: Served in the U.S. Army, Army Reserve and Nevada National Guard from 1980 to 1986, then joined the Las Vegas Metropolitan Police Department in 1988 and rose through the ranks.
Served as Clark County sheriff from 2014 to 2022 before being elected governor.
